## q-hgnvryd · open · by Boyd

Which Scaleway zone should host the server?

DEV1-M is offered in Paris, Amsterdam and Warsaw. The zone sets latency for players; BRL-kdza puts backups in a *different* region.

- [ ] Paris (fr-par) *(recommended · default if unanswered)*

  Central for France, Benelux, Spain, the UK and western Germany. Backups go to Amsterdam.

- [ ] Amsterdam (nl-ams)

  Slightly better for northern Europe and the UK. Backups go to Paris.

- [ ] Warsaw (pl-waw)

  Best for central and eastern Europe. Backups go to Paris.
